prompts.koak:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet of NEW individual game symbols for a preschool symbol-matching card game. Reference image is STYLE and object identity reference only; do not crop, trace, or paste anything from it. Generate fresh crisp high-resolution artwork. Style: the reference's simple polished colorful 3D toy objects, smooth large shapes, rounded edges, restrained soft shading, vivid clear colors, instantly recognizable small silhouettes. Keep objects simple and bold, NOT realistic, NO intricate surface detail, NO scenery, NO platforms, NO composites, NO object clusters beyond an object assembly specifically requested. Absolutely NO parrots, NO birds, NO people, NO characters or faces, NO eyes on objects, NO text except explicitly requested single digits or letter. Genuinely transparent background (alpha), no white matte, no checkerboard, no cast ground shadow. Orthographic or gentle three-quarter views. All objects separate with generous fully transparent gaps; nothing overlaps, nothing cut off. Each object centered fully inside its equal-sized cell, occupying 65-75% of that cell, with equal outer margins. No grid lines, labels, borders, cards, badges behind icons, watermarks or decorative sparkles. Highest available sharpness. Render the sheet at large resolution so each object is a sharp standalone asset, not a thumbnail. Theme: koak. EXACT GRID: 4 columns and 3 rows. EXACTLY 11 different objects in this order, one object per cell. Row 1: a white captain sailor cap with navy blue band and tiny gold anchor badge; a bright turquoise neckerchief tied in a single simple knot; a round brass compass with one red needle; a short brass-and-brown collapsible spyglass.
Row 2: a single navy-blue anchor; a red-and-white lifebuoy with no rope; a peach scallop seashell; an orange five-armed starfish.
Row 3: a plain brown wooden ship steering wheel with six spokes; a single red crab with two claws; a corked turquoise clear glass bottle with NO letter inside; EMPTY transparent final cell.
